title: Duplicate Detection — a repeated same-stage tap is not charged again
preface: This test is to confirm that a repeat tap of the same boarding stage within the duplicate window is not charged again, even after an intervening same-stage retail transaction.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded ABT test cEMV card, with its account open in the Operator Portal Journey History to verify
**AND** the back-office duplicate window ("Same Location Time") is active — **UNCONFIRMED** value 15 minutes; the spec defines a configurable same-location/duplicate-tap time but states no figure (FBD-100690 para 469); confirm live (gap Q14)
**AND** Metro capping is £4.00 with a £2.30 single fare on 10A (IN)
**AND** the card has no prior taps today

steps.content:
**WHEN** you tap the card at Casement Park (10A IN) at 09:00
**AND** you make a same-stage retail (Model 1 / KFT ticket) transaction on the device at 09:02
steps.expected:
**THEN** in Journey History the 09:00 tap is charged the full £2.30
**AND** the 09:02 retail transaction is recorded at its own ticket price

steps.content:
**WHEN** you tap again at Casement Park (10A IN) at 09:06, inside the duplicate window
**AND** you run the EndOfDay settlement
steps.expected:
**THEN** the 09:06 tap is not charged again (day total stays £2.30)
**AND** the repeat tap is indicated on the journey — **UNCONFIRMED** exact representation: the spec says duplicate taps are ignored for journey/capping/charging and flagged with an icon next to the From/To stop plus the Show More detail (FBD-100690 paras 469, 472); it does NOT describe a separate "£0.00 Duplicate" journey row (gap Q21)

change_note: Fixed mojibake (£). Grounded the duplicate-ignoring principle on the Same Location Time rule (FBD-100690 para 469) and its icon/Show More indication (para 472). Flagged the 15-minute window value as UNCONFIRMED (no figure in spec) and the "£0.00 marked Duplicate" row as UNCONFIRMED (spec ignores + flags via icon, does not create a zero row). The retail↔duplicate interaction is not in any cited paragraph — see gap.
gaps: Q14: duplicate/Same-Location window value (15 min?) not stated in FBD-100690 para 469 — confirm live.
Q21: exact Journey History representation of an ignored duplicate (icon+Show More vs a £0.00 row) — confirm live.
Whether an intervening retail transaction affects duplicate detection is not covered by any cited paragraph — GAP.

title: Duplicate Detection — an out-of-order (earlier-timestamp) repeat tap is still a duplicate
preface: This test is to confirm that a later same-stage tap, and a buffered tap that uploads out of order with an earlier timestamp, are both treated as duplicates of the original within the duplicate window.
preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded ABT test cEMV card, with its account open in the Operator Portal Journey History to verify
**AND** the back-office duplicate window is active — **UNCONFIRMED** value 15 minutes (no figure in FBD-100690 para 469; gap Q14)
**AND** Metro capping is £4.00 with a £2.30 single fare on 10A (IN)
**AND** the card has no prior taps today
**AND** a second validator was briefly offline (or its clock was skewed) so a tap it buffered uploads late, carrying a timestamp earlier than taps already processed

steps.content:
**WHEN** you tap the card at Casement Park (10A IN) at 09:00
**AND** you make a same-stage retail transaction at 09:02
**AND** you tap again at Casement Park (10A IN) at 09:06
steps.expected:
**THEN** the 09:06 tap is not charged again (day total stays £2.30)
**AND** it is flagged a duplicate of the 09:00 tap — **UNCONFIRMED** representation (FBD-100690 para 472; gap Q21)

steps.content:
**WHEN** the buffered same-stage tap uploads with an 08:58 timestamp — earlier than the 09:00 original but arriving after it (out of order), inside the window
**AND** you run the EndOfDay settlement
steps.expected:
**THEN** the 08:58 out-of-order tap is not charged (day total stays £2.30)
**AND** it is flagged a duplicate against the 09:00 tap — **UNCONFIRMED**: the spec does not state how out-of-order timestamps are ordered/linked for duplicate detection (FBD-100690 para 469); confirm live (gap Q21)

change_note: Fixed mojibake. Grounded duplicate-ignoring on FBD-100690 para 469. Removed the invented "marked Duplicate against the original / both linked" representation as asserted fact — reframed as UNCONFIRMED. Out-of-order ordering behaviour is not in the spec — GAP.
gaps: Q14: duplicate window value not stated.
Q21: out-of-order timestamp handling for duplicate detection not specified in FBD-100690 para 469 — confirm live.

**AND** you open the card's Journey History

**THEN** Journey History still shows a single journey row for that tap (taps are displayed from the boarding/alighting stops received from devices — FBD-100662 para 264)
**AND** the row is marked cancelled — **UNCONFIRMED** exact indicator: the "**" marker and the retain-after-cancel behaviour are not in the requirement specs; they read as a defect-fix acceptance criterion, not a requirement (gap Q21)
